handoff.purpose: Define compare_declared function to compare an observation against declared field names.

symbols.name: compare_declared
symbols.note: Compares observation Shape against declared field names, returning ShapeConflict. Handles edge cases: no declared names, observation has no names, truncated observation.

claims.text: Refuses to compare rather than manufacturing findings: an observation with no names (a scalar, an unstructured array, an opaque object) is comparable=False with a reason.
claims.why: When shape.names is empty, returns ShapeConflict with comparable=False and reason explaining the observation carries no field names.

claims.text: Reporting every declared field as 'missing' because the observation carries no names at all would turn 'we learned nothing here' into a wall of false positives.
claims.why: The function returns comparable=False when shape.names is empty, preventing a wall of false positives.

claims.text: if not declared: return ShapeConflict(..., comparable=False, reason='nothing was declared')
claims.why: Code explicitly checks if declared is empty and returns ShapeConflict with comparable=False and reason 'nothing was declared'.

claims.text: if not shape.names: return ShapeConflict(..., comparable=False, reason=f'the observation carries no field names ...')
claims.why: Code explicitly checks if shape.names is empty and returns ShapeConflict with comparable=False and reason including family and note.

claims.text: if shape.truncated: notes.append('observation listed ...; missing below cannot be trusted while the list is clipped')
claims.why: Code appends a note to notes list when shape.truncated is True.
Code sets missing_in_observation to empty tuple when truncated, else to missing list.

observations.what: Function returns ShapeConflict with comparable=False when no declared names or no observation names, preventing false positives.
When shape.truncated is True, missing_in_observation is set to empty tuple, which may hide missing fields. This is intentional but could be a risk if callers don't check truncated flag.
